summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style biography of Curtis Lazar, a Canadian professional ice hockey player. It states his birth date, his current team (the Buffalo Sabres of the NHL), his draft selection by the Ottawa Senators in 2013, and his junior career with the Edmonton Oil Kings, which included a 2014 Memorial Cup championship.
one_line: Canadian professional ice hockey player drafted 17th overall by the Ottawa Senators in 2013, now with the Buffalo Sabres.
key_facts: Curtis Lazar was born on February 2, 1995.
Curtis Lazar is a Canadian professional ice hockey player.
Curtis Lazar is currently playing for the Buffalo Sabres of the National Hockey League (NHL).
Curtis Lazar was selected by the Ottawa Senators in the first round (17th overall) of the 2013 NHL Entry Draft.
Curtis Lazar played junior hockey with the Edmonton Oil Kings of the Western Hockey League (WHL).
Curtis Lazar won the 2014 Memorial Cup Championship with the Edmonton Oil Kings.
